RULES.md.text:
# Agent Workflow Rules

This file is the neutral, global source of truth for workflow rules shared by configured agents.

Before the first response or action, read every Markdown file under `rules/`
beside this file in lexical order. Then read
`overlays/<current-agent>/RULES.md` when it exists.
